caption:
Stuffed Chicken with Garlick-y Mushrooms & Spinach
high protein | weeknight dinners | low carb 

Nutrition: 
C: 12 | F: 15 | P: 38
Calories: 304 per serve
Makes 3

Ingredients
3 chicken breasts 
1/2 tsp oil
6 garlic cloves, minced
200 grams button mushroom, sliced
200 grams baby spinach 
1 tsp chilli flakes
salt + black pepper, to taste
1 tsp dried basil OR any spices you want to use :) 
30 grams gouda cheese

1 tbsp cajun seasoning for the top of the chicken, optional 

Method
make the filling first, add oil to the pan and add in the garlic and mushroom and let them cook well on high heat, add in the seasonings and the spinach and cook till wilted 
flatten out your chicken breasts, this helps with even cooking 
layer with cheese and the filling and close
add the chicken to the pan and add a sprinkle of cajun seasoning 
cook on both sides and serve it with a side salad
